Effective immediately, Wilkinson High will be eliminating all extracurricular activities. Suddenly, the most apathetic teacher on the staff has a reason to get involved. But how is a typical high-school teacher like Mr. Voss supposed to raise the $48,000 needed to save the music program from going belly up? It also contains learning features to support and extend students' knowledge of tap dance, including assignments, e-journaling prompts, tests of tap dance terminology, a glossary and links to further study. The book introduces students to the dance form by detailing its physical and mental benefits. With this book, students also learn about etiquette, proper attire, class expectations, health and injury prevention for dancers.
